en: The Philippine flag's sun has eight rays, which is exactly double the four points of a standard compass, representing the first eight revolting provinces.
The Philippine Senate has exactly 24 elected members, which is much smaller than the House of Representatives that has over 300 members.
Spain colonized the Philippines for 333 years, which is significantly longer than the American colonization period of just 48 years.
Jose Rizal was only 35 years old when executed, making him younger than the current age of most grade-five teachers.
The Philippines has two official languages, Filipino and English, but citizens speak over 180 distinct indigenous languages across the archipelago.
The 18 major ethnolinguistic groups include the Tagalog, who are the most numerous, and the Ivatan, who have a much smaller population.
Fe del Mundo entered Harvard Medical School at age 18, which is four years younger than the typical American college graduate.
The 1987 Philippine Constitution contains 18 articles, whereas the shorter 1973 Constitution originally had only 17 articles before its amendments.
Filipino citizens can vote at age 18, which is two years older than the legal student-driver permit age of 16.
The Sinulog Festival in Cebu is celebrated for three days, which is much shorter than the month-long celebrations of some town fiestas.
The Philippines currently has 81 provinces, which is nearly double the 41 provinces that existed when the First Philippine Republic was established.
The Katipunan started with just seven founding members in 1892, but grew to over 100,000 members before the revolution began in 1896.
